services.desc: The A.R. Mitchell will exhibit Santa Fe Trail focused art featuring artists Ronald Kil and Leon Loughridge. About Leon Loughridge: Raised in the open ranch land of Northern New Mexico, Leon Loughridge developed an early affinity for the Southwestern landscape. He was greatly influenced by his grandmother’s involvement in Northern New Mexico art circles and by his studies at the Colorado Institute of Art. His work is exhibited nationally and collected by numerous museums including the Denver Art Museum, the Denver Public Library, and the Colorado History Museum. Molly Mellinger worked professionally in the equine industry before transitioning to a full-time artistic practice. She is a multidisciplinary artist best known for her oil paintings and drawings, with a growing interest in sculpture and mixed media expression. She lives and works in Denver, Colorado.
